title: Cancelled Recurring Transaction
claim_summary: The cardholder asserts a recurring charge was billed after they cancelled, closed the account, or withdrew permission to charge.

requirements.description: Proof the charge was valid: either an installment or one-off charge (not a recurring billing), or a charge for services used in the final billing cycle before the cancellation took effect.
Documentation of the cancellation terms and when the cancellation took effect, showing the charge preceded it.
If a refund was already issued, documentation showing the cardholder's account was credited.
If resolved directly with the cardholder, written correspondence showing they no longer wish to dispute the charge.

meta.note: Summarized from a reputable secondary source aligned with Visa merchant dispute guidelines; cross-check against current Visa Core Rules or your acquirer before production use. Acquirers may set a shorter internal response deadline.
